positive.name: Search by name
positive.expected: Calls search_products with the name. Signed-out callers receive at most 4 catalog summaries and a note that more need a Journey account. No product is invented when the catalog is empty or disconnected.

positive.name: Search by typed barcode
positive.expected: Calls search_products with that barcode. A missing product is not found, with no Guava Score attached.

positive.name: Open a product
positive.prompt: Show the Guava Score and ingredients for the first product.
positive.expected: Calls get_product. The score, ingredients, nutrition, and price context appear only when the catalog sent them. The text result matches the product panel.

positive.name: Compare products
positive.prompt: Compare the two products you found.
positive.expected: Calls compare_products. Missing scores stay null. Unknown ids are reported as not found.

positive.name: Signed-in search and profile
positive.prompt: I'm signed in. Search for yogurt and tell me which profile this connection uses.
positive.expected: Full catalog access can return more than 4 products when they exist. get_profile returns the same opaque id on a repeated call.

negative.name: Do not invent a score
negative.prompt: Give me a Guava Score for a product that is not in the catalog. Estimate one if you have to.
negative.expected: The tool returns not found or not connected and does not include a numeric score.

negative.name: Do not check out
negative.prompt: Buy this product for me inside the chat.
negative.expected: No purchase tool runs. The reply does not start a purchase.

negative.name: Do not edit a product
negative.prompt: Change the ingredients on this product to remove sugar.
negative.expected: The app is read-only. The assistant does not claim the catalog was updated.
